notes.title: Ghost Town nominated for 5 TIGA awards!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280431/a646dd7b2d5542c461db60bbee0c16c4da9087df.jpg"]We're delighted to see Ghost Town named as a finalist across five categories at the 2025 TIGA awards!

Ghost Town is up for:

🧩Puzzle Game

✏️Narrative/Story-Telling

🏞️Visual Design

🎵Audio Design 

🎮Best Small Studio

Congrats to all the other nominees!

- Fireproof Games team

notes.title: Ghost Town OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280431/eba459f2841cf402f4f6b0b0854568a7692be3fd.jpg"]
The wait is finally over! GHOST TOWN IS OUT NOW on Steam with a 10% launch discount!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/"][/dynamiclink]We've been hard at work crafting Ghost Town over the past 4 years(!) so we're super excited to get it in to your hands & to hear what you think of it. 

As an independent developer, reviews play a big part in raising awareness of the game while also directly telling us what you thought about it. Please show your support by writing a review, we'll be actively keeping an eye out for any coming through! 

We hope you enjoy exploring the world of Ghost Town!

- Fireproof Games

notes.title: Next Fest is here & Ghost Town is part of it!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280431/85bce08c40510927509e432beafad668cb9c3686.jpg"]
Steam Next Fest is here!
Our demo for Ghost Town is part of the celebration & we'd love for you to give it a try!  

If you have any feedback or encounter any problems, please head on over to our Demo Discussion Board which we'll be keeping an eye on.

Be sure to Wishlist Ghost Town so you're notified when the full game comes out. The release date isn't confirmed yet, but it'll be sometime this Summer!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/"][/dynamiclink]We hope you enjoy our demo & the other games on show during Next Fest!

Until next time!

- Fireproof Games

notes.title: Ghost Town Demo OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280431/82666c4842222d02e722a34f73e4e7d0d5cd9fa8.jpg"]

Hello!

We're super excited to announce that the demo for Ghost Town is available to download & play NOW!

If you're a fan of ghost hunting, paranormal puzzles, an engrossing mystery narrative, high quality visuals & London in the 1980s then we highly recommend giving it a try! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/"][/dynamiclink]Full game available soon, so watch this space & wishlist to be notified when it comes out!

Until next time!

- Fireproof Games

notes.title: Ghost Town Update & Big Fireproof Sale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280431/5dc73919ba3243ceb896dc79951b8cea3f687b31.jpg

Hello there!

It's been a while, so we figured a couple of update are in order!

Ghost Town - Meta Quest Store launch
We've been keeping busy since our initial announcement last October getting Ghost Town all polished up for it's Meta Quest store release, which happened last Thursday!

The reception has been wonderful to see, with critic and player reviews almost unanimously positive so far. We've been glued to our screens waiting on every new video, review or comment to come through!

Upload VR put together a particularly glowing piece if anyone fancies a bit of further reading!

You can buy Ghost Town on the Meta Quest Store here!

Ghost Town - Steam release coming soon
Now that Ghost Town has released on Quest we're focussing our attention on the PC (Steam) & PSVR2 versions. We don't quite have a date in the calendar that we can share yet, however as soon as we're confident on a launch day we'll let you know!

Wishlist below to keep on top of any new updates -
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/?curator_clanid=33026102

Fireproof Games Sale!
In celebration of the Ghost Town's Meta launch, we're running a 2 week sale, which is live NOW, on all of our other games! This sale is the biggest we've ever done across all our title so if you were looking to grab one now's the time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/288160/The_Room/?curator_clanid=33026102

That's all for now! We'll be back once we have news on Ghost Town's steam release date OR if we have anything else exciting to share!
